description: Create a seed inventory spreadsheet for a spring exchange event. Open OnlyOffice Spreadsheet and create a file at /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/seed_exchange_inventory.xlsx. Add headers in row 1: 'Variety Name', 'Plant Type', 'Seeds Available', 'Year Saved', 'Germination Notes'. Add three seed entries: Row 2: 'Brandywine Tomato', 'Tomato', 45, 2024, 'Good germination last year'. Row 3: 'Detroit Dark Red Beet', 'Beet', 30, 2023, 'Older seeds - test before trading'. Row 4: 'Scarlet Nantes Carrot', 'Carrot', 60, 2024, 'Fresh seeds, high confidence'. Save the spreadsheet (Ctrl+S).
